source.author: verg
source.text: At non in Venerem segnes nocturnaque bella aut ubi curva choros indixit tibia Bacchi, exspectate dapes et plenae pocula mensae, hic amor, hoc studium, dum sacra secundus haruspex nuntiet ac lucos vocet hostia pinguis in altos!
source.text_original: At non in Venerem segnes nocturnaque bella / aut ubi curva choros indixit tibia Bacchi, / exspectate dapes et plenae pocula mensae, / hic amor, hoc studium, dum sacra secundus haruspex / nuntiet ac lucos vocet hostia pinguis in altos!'
source.text_english: But not slack in love with Venus and in the night’s battles, or when the curved flute summons the dances of Bacchus, eagerly awaited are the feasts and the cups of the laden table. This is their love, this their devotion, while a favorable haruspex announces the rites and a fat victim calls the groves to the heights.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: non illo certior alter pinguia letifera perfringere colla bipenni.
reuse.text_original: non illo certior alter / pinguia letifera perfringere colla bipenni.
reuse.text_english: no other was more certain than he to shatter the fat lethal necks with a two-edged axe.
